newsitem.title: USA: Western National issues $130 mln equity.
newsitem.headline: Western National issues $130 mln equity.

text.p: Western National Corp said on Friday it had agreed to issue $130 million of additional equity to American General Corp.
Western said it would issue 7,254,464 shares of a newly created class of Series A participating convertible preferred stock to American General at $17.92 per share.
Net proceeds of about $126 million will be used to enhance the capital base of its principal operating subsidiary, Western National Life Insurance Co, Western said.

The transaction, expected to be completed next week, will increase American General's equity interest in Western to about 46.2 percent from 40 percent, and increase the number of Western common and common-equivalent shares outstanding to 69.7 million from 62.4 million, the company said.
The newly created preferred stock will be equivalent on an economic basis to Western's common stock but will have no voting rights, except to the extent required by Delaware law.
